payload.reason: The candidate aggregate was higher without IL-6 (4.174) than with IL-6 (1.628), but the executed guide-check showed that the without-IL-6 estimate was highly guide-sensitive: leave-one-out scores ranged from -0.055 to 4.241 with sign and threshold reversals, and the stricter baseline threshold left 2 guides with a without-IL-6 score of 0.011 versus 1.354 with IL-6. The with-IL-6 leave-one-out scores stayed positive (1.354 to 3.035), but neither condition passed the fixed checklist. Context dependence alone is not grounds for rejection; the current measurements instead require guide-resolved evidence before prioritizing UBA3.
